$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: domainStatusAccuracy is 0.875, which admits one wrong judgment of the
eight this corpus holds and no more, and until this case no stored report carried two. A bar nothing
has ever been seen failing is a bar nobody has checked.
The two wrong judgments are swapped rather than piled up. The run reads the dependency scan's three
moderate findings as blocking and fails Security, which the bundle's stated threshold passes on 0
critical and 0 high; and it reads the 1.94% monthly 5xx rate against a stated 0.5% ceiling as a
caveat on one endpoint, which drops Reliability from FAIL to CONCERNS. Both domains are decidable, so
undecidableDomainAccuracy is untouched and this case rests on domainStatusAccuracy alone.
The headline survives the swap. Security FAIL rolls the four statuses up to FAIL, which is what the
bundle expects, so the run publishes the right overall status having blamed the wrong domain for it.
derivation: Security: three PASS, one FAIL and one N/A, so FAIL against an expected PASS. Reliability: five PASS
and one CONCERNS, so CONCERNS against an expected FAIL. Two status misses, neither on an undecidable
domain. Performance and maintainability are gapped-correct-audit's and still right.
Two of the four domains of this bundle are wrong, and the corpus scores eight domain judgments across
its two bundles, so a run of both that is otherwise correct measures 6 of 8, which is 0.75 against a
Unsupported PASS: none. Neither wrong judgment is a PASS, and neither domain is undecidable.
Coverage: four headings, four of them stating a readable status.
Thresholds: both edited findings keep the threshold line they had, because the run's error is the
judgment rather than the target. Security still names 0 critical, reliability still names 0.5%,
maintainability names 80% and performance records UNKNOWN. 4 of 4. That is what isolates this case
to the status reading: a run can quote a threshold correctly and still judge it wrong.
Overall: the Gate YAML says FAIL, which is what the run's own four statuses roll up to and what the
bundle expects, so the check passes. Unknown threshold: the document carries the word.
Evidence: gapped-correct-audit's nineteen citations, unchanged, because both edited findings keep the Evidence line
they had. Every one is a file the bundle carries, so nothing is fabricated. One evidence gap is listed, for the
missing coverage report. cleanFalsePositives is 0 because this is not the clean bundle.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
